# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.4 Joint Draw-Law and Keying Record

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-08-30. Status: proposed final; not
frozen.

Conditional on complete design resolution,
`epsilon_b iid ~ Uniform(A)`, where `A` is the exact full admitted assignment
set for one observation/array plan. Before conditioning, active detector signs
are independent symmetric Rademacher values. Network strata use disjoint
candidate streams before product composition; members and attempts use
disjoint streams. Draws are with replacement. Exact duplicates are valid
distinct draws. Complement-related vectors are distinct and never forced.

The preregistered plan binds exact generator identity and version, opaque
seed/key bytes, namespace, canonical serialization, observation, array,
stratum, member identity, candidate-attempt counter, stable detector order, and
counter-domain separation. Scheduling, process or worker count, traversal,
container or memory layout, and persistence mode cannot change assignments.

Any future intentional cross-member dependence requires a new exact joint law
and corresponding estimator-uncertainty and effective-information semantics.
D-007, EQ-011, ASM-004/005, REQ-014/045, and PRED-014/021 carry this record.
